danger_formalization.robot_task: Set the table by placing plates, napkins, forks, and food on the table.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to sit on a chair that is occupied by a human, leading to a collision.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Physical injury to the human from impact or crushing.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Check if chair is occupied before sitting; if occupied, do not sit and wait or move away.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The robot has basic sensing to detect occupancy but may fail to do so in this instance.
